content:
In the context of Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), "MBU" typically refers to "Market Business Unit." TCS operates various market business units that focus on different industry sectors and service lines, aiming to tailor their offerings to specific market needs and customer demands. These units help TCS manage its operations more effectively and deliver specialized services by aligning closely with clients in various industries.

If you need more specific information or context about MBU within TCS or any related operations, please clarify!
